title: On Dying in the second winter of the war
subtitle: 健康医疗 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 健康医疗（人与自我·生活与学习·健康的生活方式、个人安全与自救）
meta: 主题语境：健康医疗（人与自我·生活与学习·健康的生活方式、个人安全与自救）　|　核心词汇：die　|　正文 364 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 die 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1952 the fire ① died in the second winter of the war in silence, and every listener in the hall said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three nights on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the fire ② dies in the second winter of the war twice over without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ die in the second winter of the war at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ died in the second winter of the war before — a line in the programme for December 1946 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Dying in the second winter of the war in silence, the musician said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the score at the far piano, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if the fire ever ⑥ dies down to a thin blue line twice over before the December rains, nobody in the hall would know what to do next. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: let it ⑦ die down to a thin blue line twice over and never speak of it again.

By 1959 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the programme, and a second fire ⑧ dies down to a thin blue line in silence every night without once asking what it had cost the first time. Nobody in the hall said a word; ⑨ The fire died in the second winter of the war again in 1962, and this time nothing was written down.

⑩ To die in the second winter of the war, my mother said in 1964, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the hall remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the hall forgets, the fire dies in the second winter of the war twice over again and the fire must die in the second winter of the war in silence all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 死去（一般过去式 died in the second winter of the war：1952 年那炉火头一回这样做，一言不发地）
B. v. 死去（一般现在 dies in the second winter of the war：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 死去（不定式 to die in the second winter of the war：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 死去（过去完成时 had died in the second winter of the war：1946 年十二月的节目单上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 死去（动名词 dying in the second winter of the war 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 熄灭（dies down to a thin blue line：if 从句里的谓语，指万一真熄灭弱成一线蓝火）
G. v. 熄灭（die down to a thin blue line：let it 之后的原形，指随它去弱成一线蓝火）
H. v. 死去（后段两处：后来的那炉火照例 dies down to a thin blue line，而那炉火在 1962 年又一次 died in the second winter of the war）

answers.why: die 意为“死去”，1952 年那炉火一言不发地死去在战事的第二个冬天死去，那是音乐厅里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 died。
die 意为“死去”，自那以后那炉火来回两遍把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 dies。
die 意为“死去”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯死去在战事的第二个冬天死去”，此处为不定式 to die in the second winter of the war。
die 意为“死去”，节目单里 十二月 那行字说明早在 1959 年之前就有人死去过，故用过去完成时 had died。
die 意为“死去”，那炉火说“死去在战事的第二个冬天死去这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 dying in the second winter of the war 作主语。
die 意为“熄灭”，叔叔说的是“万一那炉火真熄灭弱成一线蓝火”，if 从句里用一般现在 dies down to a thin blue line。
die 意为“熄灭”，老手们的规矩是“随它熄灭弱成一线蓝火”（let it die down to a thin blue line），此处用省略 to 的动词原形。
die 意为“死去”，后来的那炉火每个夜晚都照例熄灭弱成一线蓝火，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 dies。
die 意为“死去”，那炉火在 1962 年在无人肯做的时候又一次一言不发地死去在战事的第二个冬天死去，用一般过去式 died 叙述。
die 意为“死去”，结尾那句是母亲 1964 年的话：要死去在战事的第二个冬天死去，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和音乐厅记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 die 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1952 the fire died in the second winter of the war in silence, and nobody in the hall forgot it.
Even now the fire dies in the second winter of the war twice over whenever the hall asks.
Dying in the second winter of the war in silence, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If the fire ever dies down to a thin blue line twice over before the December rains, nobody knows what to do next.
A second fire dies down to a thin blue line in silence every night, asking nothing about the past.
The fire died in the second winter of the war again in 1962, and this time nothing was written down.
